title: Clear aligners for beautiful smiles create a challenge for the dental management of recycling and microplastics
html: Clear aligners, an increasingly popular alternative to fixed orthodontic braces, are expected to rise in the global clear aligner market from $4.23 billion in 2025 to $10.17 billion by 2032, reflecting a compound annual growth rate of 13.4% over the forecast period.1 This rapid growth is driven by the rising demand by patients for esthetics, comfort over fixed braces, and the convenience of treatment.2
